quick_english: There — the initiation for perfection of refinement for the knowledge-fit, and the with-seed release-initiation for those incapable of that: once it is performed, the guru should teach the lifelong remaining course.
There the remaining course is threefold — daily, occasional, desired-for. The last belongs to the practitioner alone; it is not decided here.
There the regularly occurring is the daily; identity-with-that alone is the occasional; serving it are twilight worship, daily practice, festival day, sacred thread, and the rest.
That too is daily, by fixedness of its own time — say some.
But the occasional, even for those abiding in his teaching, is irregular — namely the coming of guru and his circle, their festival day, knowledge-gaining day, and the rest — say some.
There fixed worship, twilight worship, guru worship, festival worship, sacred thread — thus unfailing.

Occasional are gaining knowledge, gaining scripture, the coming to the guru's circle's house, their birth-refinement-going days, worldly festival, scripture exposition, beginning-middle-end, seeing deities, gathering, dream command, gaining rule-expiation — this occasional is the cause of special worship.

There the disciple's chief mantra — with power, whose essence is consciousness-flash, unwritten — one should transmit by mouth-lineage alone. Then, to perfect identity-with-that, the disciple should practice identity at the twilights; through that, at all times, to perfect such refinement-gain; and daily one should worship the Supreme Lord on altar or liṅga.

There, on a heart-pleasing altar, meditated as a stainless mirror — having seen one's very form, non-different from the worshippable deity-wheel, as it were body-reflected — one should worship with heart-pleasing flowers, scents, wine, libations, food, smoke, lamps, gifts, praise, song, music, dance and the rest; murmur; praise — to obtain doubt-free identity-with-that.
For in a mirror, one gazing ceaselessly at one's own face — certainty of its nature swiftly comes about. And here no order is chief — apart from identity-with-that.

Entered into identity with the supreme mantra, his beast-latency stain gone, his whole snare-net of bonds melted by devotion-taste penetration — whatever heart dwells in that is highest to be taken up, say our gurus.
Having lain upon the flood of being, the ultimate-minded flashes forth light — which —
supreme-nectar-vision-ness — by her they are worshipped, the secret-knowers.
Having made the ground-bearing, sprinkled in the moment with wonder-taste — with taken, mentally, own-being flowers exuding own fragrance.
From the course of the priceless cup of my bliss-nectar-full heart — you with the Goddess together, in the body-temple of God, I worship day and night.
The sense stated in two verses contemplated within — one should contemplate the deity-wheel.
Then showing seals, murmuring, offering of that.
Dismissal through unity with the to-be-awakened.
The chief food-offering one should eat oneself, or cast all into water — for the water-born living are previously initiated, through oblation-food — say the scripture-knowers.

But in eating cats, mice, dogs and the rest, doubt is born — for hell. Even the knower, from wish to favor the world, should not do such; or, leaving the world, one should stay — thus is altar-sacrifice.

Now on the liṅga: there one should not install the liṅga with secret mantras; especially the manifest — thus on previously installed ones, in invocation-dismissal order, one should do worship, as the support.

There guru's body, own body, Śakti's body, secret-scripture book, hero's cup, rosary, weapon, arrow-thing, pearl, golden, made of flowers, scents, substances and dear things, mirror or as liṅga one should worship.

There, by support-power alone comes ever-greater mantra-success — thus earlier and earlier is chief, since following the support's qualities; and of mantras, there in the to-be-won, each chief — say the scripture-gurus.
Everywhere pride of non-difference from the Supreme Lord alone is the highest refinement.
Now the festival rule.
There general, general-general, general-special, special-general, special, special-special — thus sixfold festival, from completion of the rite.
From completion of the rite.

There in each month first and fifth days are general; fourth, eighth, ninth, fourteenth, fifteenth of both fortnights are general-general; on both of these too, in fitting planet-star conjunctions on each stated tithi, general-special. Mārgaśīrṣa's first night-quarter, on dark ninth; Pauṣa's midnight, on dark ninth; Māgha's midnight, on bright fifteenth; Phālguna's midday, on bright twelfth; Caitra's on bright thirteenth; Vaiśākha's on dark eighth; Jyaiṣṭha's on dark ninth; Āṣāḍha's on first day; Śrāvaṇa's day fore-part, on dark eleventh; Bhādrapada's midday, on bright sixth; Āśvayuja's bright-ninth day; Kārttika's first night-quarter, on bright ninth — thus special festival.
Citrā-moon, Maghā-Jupiter, Tiṣya-moon, Pūrva-phalgunī-Mercury, Śravaṇa-Mercury, Śatabhiṣak-moon, Diti's two, Rohiṇī-Venus, Viśākhā-Jupiter, Śravaṇa-moon — thus.
If in Mārgaśīrṣa-first order in due numbers it is, excluding Āśvayuja — then special-special.
If another special is on another festival, then that is after-festival, they say.
In star-planet conjunction, time is not chief.
The tithi alone — from special gain; but continuity of after-rite time on festival day is chief. By after-rite primacy: of festival rites, after-rite is image-rite and wheel-rite — synonyms.

There the guru, his circle with offspring, knower of truth, maiden, outcast woman, courtesan, bleeding woman, truth-knowing woman or — in wheel-rite the chief to be worshipped, especially collectively.

There in the middle the guru, in his covering-order — from guru to the bound ones, hero and power in order — thus in wheel or row formation one should sit. Then with scents, smoke, flowers and the rest in order one should worship. Then, having contemplated the vessel as Sadāśiva-formed, having filled with wine meditated as Śakti-nectar, there having worshipped the enjoyer-power as Śiva, having thereby sated the deity-wheel, having contemplated the triad-meeting of man, power, and Śiva in nature, in covering-descent order — primacy of release and enjoyment, outside and inside — one should do sating; then in re-circulation order — thus the complete circling nourishes the wheel.

There, having placed the universe-made vessel on the base, having sated the deity-wheel, one should sate oneself with the saluted. If no vessel — auspicious folded shell-hands; or with the right hand vessel-shaped — auspicious — with two, right laid above, made jointless, folded shell-hands; with falling drops vetālas and guhyakas are pleased, by the flow Bhairava. Here entry is to be given to no one; if by mistake one entered, one should make no doubt; having made, again double wheel-rite one should do. Then fried foods, meals and the rest before, as desired, should be scattered — in a hidden house or, without code-names, by the word deity one should join all — thus is hero-mixture rite.
Then at the end with gifts, betel, clothes and the rest one should sate — thus this most excellent image-rite.

Even unseen-maṇḍala, by image-rite worshipping festival days, within a year alone gains the fruit stated for putrakas — without twilight practices and the rest. Thus for the old, enjoyers, women is this rule — when power descends, to be taught by the guru.
Now the sacred-thread rule.
And it in Ratnamālā, Triśiromata, Siddhāmata and the rest is preceded by rule and fulfills the Lord's command — and this is said in the Tantrāloka: without the sacred thread, all is fruitless — thus.
There from bright Āṣāḍha up to Kula-full-moon day-end the sacred thread is to be done; there Kārttika dark fifteenth fulfills Kula-wheel and daily-wheel — say the Nitya-tantra knowers.
Māgha bright fifteenth — say the Bhairavakulormi knowers.
Southern-course-end fifteenth — say the Tantrasadbhāva knowers.

There according to means, having worshipped the God, having sated with oblation, one should give the sacred thread — one should make from gold-pearl-jewel-made beginning up to cloth-thread-cotton-kuśa-wombed even.

And that with tattva-number knots, and with pada-kalā-bhuvana-varṇa-mantra-number knots — one knee-ending, another navel-ending, another throat-ending, another on the head — thus four sacred threads to the God and to the guru, by contemplating all-paths-full forms, one should give; to the rest one — thus.

Then great festival is to be held — four-month, seven-day, three-day — thus chief and fallback courses. When means exist, monthly the sacred thread; or in four months; or once. In not doing it, one should murmur expiation. Even the knower, even with means, in not doing incurs; in greed-covered knowledge non-doing, from disgrace of knowledge.
When, even having attained wisdom, the Lord's teaching is defiled — then needing expiation.
Thus by the statement.
Thus this is sacred-thread rule.

At knowledge-gaining and the rest, at worldly festival's end too — everywhere excess of consciousness-blaze, nearness of the deity-wheel especially comes about — thus by considering such excess, just such distinction, in after-rite and the rest, one should do.
Now exposition rule.

One should request the guru complete in all scriptures for exposition — he too, to own disciple or even another's, should expound scripture fit for fit refinement; even to one abiding in lower teaching, from compassion, his heart stirred by hope of power-descent born of the Lord's varied will, one should expound — excluding secret teaching.

There, exposition made for the devoted seated low, of restrained speech-mind-body, becomes fruitful. First, on ground smeared with perfumes and the rest, having drawn or resolved — lotus-base, four-cornered, lotus-triad, in lotus-middle Vāgīśī, on left and right Gaṇapati and guru — one should worship; on the base-lotus, the exposition-worthy wish-deity.

Then, having sated the wheel with the common offering-vessel rite, one should expound — sūtra-sentence-chapter text, uncontradicted before and after, making first the position rightly joined, rightly refuting, proving the provandum, showing the drift, one should expound to chapter's end, no more; even there, at each section's end, sating and worship — until exposition's close.
Then too, having worshipped, having dismissed the knowledge-seat, having smeared, one should cast it in the deep.
Thus exposition rule.
Now rule-expiation.
Though even the truth-knowing-established needs no expiation and the rest, yet to favor those who share release through conduct alone, one should show the conduct-course.

But the truth-unknowing, whose enjoyment-release hangs on conduct alone — if the rule is crossed, not doing expiation, becomes a raw-flesh eater for a hundred years, thus the expiation rule is to be stated. There in woman-slaying there is no expiation; elsewhere, having known strength-weakness, unbroken Goddess Mālinī from one time beginning up to three hundred thousand one should repeat, until doubt falls away. At its end special worship; even there wheel-rite — for it everywhere is remaining.
Thus rule-expiation rule.
Now guru-worship rule.
At all rites' ends, the rite gathered in, next day one should do guru-worship — for before, as rite-limb he is pleased, not chiefly — thus doing it chiefly, not doing, by office-bond one is bound.
Thus it in every way one should do.

There, having drawn a svāstika maṇḍala, there having given a golden seat, there having worshipped the entire path-course, having installed that seat by that, to him having done worship, sating, meal, gift, self — thus having offered, the food-leavings having begged, having bowed, oneself having tasted, one should do wheel-worship.
Thus? is guru-worship rule.
